title: Real Madrid's biggest sales
brief: Name the ten players Real Madrid have sold for the biggest fees since July 2000, ranked by the guaranteed fee in euros reported at the time.
period: Transfers from July 2000 to the end of the summer 2026 window (1 September 2026). Ranked by the guaranteed fee in euros as reported at the time; add-ons are left out. A loan with an obligation to buy counts at the obligation fee.

notes.Gonzalo Higuain: Gonzalo Higuain is 11th, just outside: €37m plus €3m bonuses to Napoli in 2013 (Newstalk, TM €39m).
notes.Martin Odegaard: Martin Odegaard is 12th, just outside: about €35m to Arsenal in 2021.
notes.Nico Paz: Nico Paz: Transfermarkt lists his 2024 move to Como at €66m, which looks like a data error: reports at the time said about €6m. Left out.

checks: Every fee was read from Transfermarkt's club or league record page and checked against a news report (BBC, Sky, Reuters, AP, ESPN, the Guardian, Eurosport, kicker, Calcio e Finanza, A Bola or the club's statement, as named per row in transfers.csv). Where a report splits a fee into a fixed part and add-ons, the fixed part is used, so several fees are lower than Transfermarkt's (which usually adds add-ons paid or agency costs). Where a player went the other way as part of the fee, only the cash is counted unless the clubs stated a fee for each player (Arthur and Pjanic, Cancelo and Danilo, Cillessen and Neto).
